🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* United States \(USTR / Trump Administration policies\)
• *Announcement:* Trade negotiations between the United States and India are highly contentious, with Indian suppliers actively planning to diversify away from the US market due to a looming threat of 100\% tariffs\. The US has also accused India of aiding China in tariff evasion\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(75\% \- Official reports indicate ongoing bilateral trade tensions and the explicit prospect of 100\% tariffs due to various factors including India's trade with Russia and alleged tariff evasion, though not yet a finalized order\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Textiles, Auto Components, EMS, Chemicals \(export\-oriented\), Pharma, IT Services
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(Escalating trade tensions and potential tariffs on key Indian exports to the US create a risk\-off sentiment, leading to potential capital withdrawals\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Fund managers should consider trimming exposure to Indian sectors with high export reliance on the US market, focusing instead on domestic demand\-driven equities\.
